text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "—If I put on an amazing performance in this race."

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
"She's the top of the top on dirt, after all!
It's only natural for the Chief who raised her to be proud~."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Finally, you get it too, don'tcha?
I'm—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I ain't weak!
I'm plenty strong, dammit...!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haah...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
*cough, cough*... *hack*...
Hehe... I did decently well, but
still... I've got a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...And yet, you've got such a satisfied look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The reason for that is...
because we can finally get started from here~.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "Haaahn? What do you mean, 'get started'!?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
……
My family runs a boxing gym, you see~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"There are plenty of folks out there
giving it their all to take back their lives."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even if they stumble, they want to make things right somehow.
Thinking like that, they push their body to the limit
and work so hard, you see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "I want to be a source of courage for people like that."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even if things don't go as planned,
all you have to do is get back up and try again.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Everyone starts out weak. But there's really nothing to be ashamed of.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The weaker I am, the more I'll just train—
heaps and heaps—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I just have to become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Acute-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, we're on our way.
Rickey-chan, Tarumae-chan."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well now, what kind of training should we do today?
I've got plenty of things to reflect on
after that last race...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Eh, you ran great though!?
Tarumae and I were watching!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Rickey-chan.
Well now... maybe there was some good to it after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
“There were flaws too, right?
We need to properly review and address them.”

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ha... haha.
What's your problem?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Going around telling everyone else too!
Saying she's no good, that she's lacking—

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Admit to yourself first that you're weak!
—Otherwise, you won't ever get any stronger!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Shut up...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, shut up, shut up!!
Shut the heeeeeeeeell uuuuup!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why am I... remembering this again?!
I went out for a run... just to forget it...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Trainerrr!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...The next...—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Pick the next race already!
Throw me into a GⅠ!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I won the Nambu Hai.
And I ran the Champions Cup all the way to the end!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
A strong Umamusume! So strong nobody can complain!
A strong Umamusume! ...So strong...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
......Hurry up and decide...! Make up your mind!
Otherwise...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That noisy jerk again...
That damn noisy bastard's back...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City held her head in agony.
Her expression was far from that of a "champion."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Please, I'm begging you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I flip through the calendar to check the GⅠ race schedule.
The Tokyo Daishoten... is far too close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With enough time so as not to burden her body,
and in a GⅠ race...—
choice_data_list: Let's enter the February Stakes in February.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A 1600m dirt mile contest held at Tokyo Racecourse.
With this, both the conditions and her strengths
are completely aligned.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Understood...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going to sleep a little...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She collapsed onto the sofa behind her just like that. Lying on her back... then on her side, placing a hand over her eyelids complaining the light was too bright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Gradually curling up into a ball.
